DT-L.form: PASS if sensitivity >= 0.6 and PPV >= 0.5 over the eligible gaps after the session's first fall (a gap is predicted to fall at P >= 0.5); NOT SCORED under 3 later falls

DT-N.form: eligible gap: its zone opens at least one heartbeat period after the process's first launch, and the launch before it ran at >= 0.65 GHz; expected = (sum of stamp gaps + n x delta) / the period; band from the lower Poisson 2.5% point at delta 0.0 ms to the upper 97.5% point at delta 1.2 ms
